outlook.statement: The Management is hopeful that as per mandate given by Hon'ble Supreme Court, the company would be able to generate sufficient funds to complete the projects as per timelines notified in the award of contracts.
The Board of Directors are exploring various possible options for completion of ongoing projects and are trying to generate additional possible revenues by construction of new flats.
Construction activities initiated in 51 residential and commercial projects; pre-construction processes and statutory approvals underway for remaining projects, some pending Supreme Court directions.
Tendering process for project completion floated in Lots; Lot-5 (10 tenders) approved by Supreme Court in Jan 2026; Lot-6 (26 tenders, 15 finalized) approved by Board in May 2026.
Environmental Clearances and Consent to Establish obtained for Kolkata, Bengaluru, and Noida projects; Chennai projects pending ground water permission.

Tenders were being re-tendered and 11 fresh Tenders have been floated. With the floatation of these tenders, there remained around 17 Tenders for various works which were decided to be floated as part of Lot-7 Tenders, as per the decision of the Board of Directors, taken in its meeting held on 28.05.2026.
The Hon'ble Supreme Court vide its order dated 29.04.2026 has approved refund of the outstanding principal amount (up to Rs. 40,000/-) deposited by the FD holders with Unitech.

The Board of Directors considered the matter by Circulation on 26.09.2025 and approved the same. Accordingly, the Management uploaded the Public Notice dated 01.10.2025 on the website of the Company giving time to the interested Homebuyers to apply for the Change of Options up to 31.10.2025 (2400 hours).

The outlook for 2026 and beyond is promising with continued foreign direct investment (FDI) in construction and real estate expansion into Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, luxury housing and branded residences seeing strong demand along with the integration of ESG frameworks into project planning and execution.
India's real estate market is projected to experience a substantial increase, potentially reaching a value of US$ 5-7 trillion by the year 2047, with the possibility of surpassing US$ 10 trillion.
Real estate sector in India is expected to reach US$ 1 trillion in market size by 2030, up from US$ 200 billion in 2021.

FY 2026-27 will continue with healthy sales momentum backed by solid structural foundation, sustained demand and relatively affordable albeit somewhat higher housing loan rates. The real estate sector is expected to maintain stable growth in FY 2026-27, backed by key drivers like urbanization, infrastructure push, capital market reforms, and digital adoption.

The new management, working under the overall guidance and supervision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court, is committed to fulfilling the statutory and contractual obligations of the Company to adhere to the Sustainability and Economic Responsibilities of the Company's business for Environmental, Social and Governance aspects.

The management is aggressively working on obtaining statutory approvals (Renewal of Licenses, Fire NOCs, Airport Authority NOCs, Building Plan approvals, Environmental Clearances, Consents to Establish) for projects where contracts have been awarded but works have not commenced.

The Company endeavours to take required measures to upgrade the reporting system in line with the proposals submitted in the Resolution Framework and directions of the Hon'ble Supreme Court to bridge gaps in BRSR reporting.
The construction and completion programme of various projects is expected to be completed over a time-frame of about 05 years subject to timely availability of all statutory approvals.
It is planned to complete a total of about 3,500 Residential and Commercial units during FY 2026-27.

The Board of Directors, appointed by the Union of India with approval of Hon'ble Supreme Court, is estimating contractual liabilities and final outcome of contingent liabilities from realizable value of available assets. The Hon'ble Supreme Court has directed dialogue with secured creditors for One Time Settlement (OTS) and meetings have been held. The Hon'ble Supreme Court has stayed sale of unsold inventories. Next hearing scheduled for 28th May 2026.

In the FY 2026-27, the Management has plans to complete the statutory audit of most of the Indian subsidiaries to make compliance of the regulations 33(h) of Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements of SEBI
Management hopeful that per Supreme Court mandate, company will generate sufficient funds to complete projects per contract timelines and continue as going concern; expressing doubts is premature
Board exploring options for project completion and generating additional revenues through new flat construction
OTS dialogue with secured creditors initiated per Supreme Court orders (meetings held March-April 2026); recommendations placed before Court
Impairment study for goodwill to be conducted with independent experts; previously impaired Rs. 18.79 cr in FY 2020-21
Reconciliation of customer sub-ledgers in progress (16,000 files audited by professional firm; 3 projects completed)
GST input credit reconciliation initiated in FY 2024-25; to be completed at annual return filing

The company is hopeful to sell unsold properties at current market value, which would cover substantial portion of the deficit of onerous projects by the surplus generating sub-projects covered under one Lease Deed/ License.
The Management will be in a position to assess the impact thereof only in due course of time after the Projects are completed and handed over.

The Board of Directors, appointed by the Union of India with approval of Hon'ble Supreme Court, is estimating contractual liabilities and final outcome of contingent liabilities from realizable value of available assets. The Hon'ble Supreme Court has directed the Board and banks to engage in dialogue for One Time Settlement (OTS) and disbursement of sanctioned loans to homebuyers. The next hearing is scheduled for 28th May 2026.

orders_or_contracts.statement: The Hon'ble Supreme Court permitted the Unitech Management to award contracts in respect of 49 (15+34) Tenders qua Lot-1 & Lot-2 on 03.11.2023.
Contracts have been awarded in the case of 25 Tenders pursuant to the approval of the BoD, Justice Sapre and the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
23 Tenders were awarded to successful L-1 bidders in December, 2024 pursuant to the order dated 04.12.2024 of the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

10 Tenders (including 01 Retrofitting Tender of Cascades- Kolkata) of Lot-5 were approved by BoD in its meeting held on 03.04.2025, subject to the approval by Justice (Retd.) A.M. Sapre and the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
The Hon'ble Supreme Court, vide its order dated 22.01.2026 granted its approval to award the 01 Tender for retrofitting works, out of 10 Tenders of Lot-5 to successful L-1 bidder.

Management floated 51 Tenders as part of Lot-2; 34 Tenders approved by BoD and Justice (Retd.) A.M. Sapre; Hon'ble Supreme Court permitted award of contracts for 49 Tenders (15+34) of Lot-1 & Lot-2; Letters of Intent issued to 23 Contractors.

Lot-1: 15 Tenders awarded (out of 35 floated). Lot-2: 49 Tenders of 39 Projects awarded. Lot-3: 38 Tenders awarded. Lot-4: 23 Tenders awarded. Lot-5: 10 Tenders approved by BoD, 1 retrofitting tender approved by Supreme Court. Lot-6: 26 Tenders floated (15 re-tendered, 11 fresh). Lot-7: ~17 Tenders to be floated.
49 tenders (15 from Lot-1 + 34 from Lot-2) awarded to 23 contractors for 39 projects pursuant to Supreme Court order dated 03.11.2023
38 tenders from Lot-3 approved by BoD and Justice Sapre on 18.02.2024, submitted to Supreme Court for approval
23 tenders from Lot-4 awarded to successful L-1 bidders in December 2024 pursuant to Supreme Court order dated 04.12.2024
10 tenders from Lot-5 (including 1 retrofitting tender for Cascades-Kolkata) approved by BoD on 03.04.2025, 1 retrofitting tender approved by Supreme Court on 22.01.2026
26 tenders floated as Lot-6 on 28.05.2026 (15 re-tenders + 11 fresh), ~17 tenders planned for Lot-7
